nagoya-to-takayama.name: Nagoya ↔ Takayama
nagoya-to-takayama.approx_cost: JR limited express Hida, 2h20m-2h40m, ten services a day. Ekitan: ¥5,610 unreserved, ¥6,140 reserved, ¥8,410 Green car; other sources give ¥6,340-6,540 for a reserved seat.

takayama-jinya.hours: 8:45-17:00 (Apr-Oct); 8:45-16:30 (Nov-Mar); ticket window closes 30 min before closing
